get.description: Retrieve a list of accounts available in the data sync service. This endpoint supports pagination to navigate through large sets of accounts. Use this endpoint to access account details for integration or management purposes.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: The paging cursor token of the last successfully read resource. Use this token to retrieve the next set of results in a paged response.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of results to display per page. Defaults to 100.

get.description: Retrieve detailed information about a specific account using its unique identifier. This endpoint is useful for accessing account details such as the account's name, status, and associated connection IDs.

parameters.name: accountId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the account to retrieve. It is an integer value.

get.description: Retrieve a list of connections for data synchronization in your HubSpot account. This endpoint allows you to filter connections by account ID and paginate through results using a cursor-based approach. It is useful for managing and reviewing the connections established for data synchronization purposes.

parameters.name: accountId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the account whose connections you want to list.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: The paging cursor token of the last successfully read resource. Use this for pagination to retrieve the next set of results.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of results to display per page. Defaults to 100.

get.description: Retrieve detailed information about a specific data sync connection using its unique identifier. This endpoint is useful for obtaining the current status and configuration details of a connection, which can aid in monitoring and managing data synchronization processes.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the connection to retrieve.

post.description: Activate a specific data sync connection in your HubSpot account. This operation enables the connection identified by the connectionId, allowing data synchronization to commence. It is useful for starting data flows between connected applications.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the connection to activate.

get.description: Retrieve the analysis of a specific data sync connection. This endpoint provides insights into the connection's status and any findings related to its operation. It is useful for diagnosing issues or understanding the current state of a connection.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the connection to analyze.

post.description: Disable a specific data sync connection identified by the connectionId. This action pauses the synchronization process for the specified connection, making it inactive until re-enabled.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the connection to disable.

post.description: Enable a specific data sync connection in your HubSpot account. This operation activates the connection identified by the connectionId, allowing data synchronization to proceed as configured. Use this endpoint to resume data sync operations for a connection that was previously disabled.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the connection to enable.

get.description: Retrieve the field mappings for a specific connection in your HubSpot account. This endpoint allows you to view how fields are mapped between HubSpot and a connected app. It supports pagination to handle large sets of mappings.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the connection for which to retrieve field mappings.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: The paging cursor token of the last successfully read resource will be returned as the `paging.next.after` JSON property of a paged response containing more results.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of results to display per page. Defaults to 100.

get.description: Retrieve the health status of a specific data sync connection in your HubSpot account. This endpoint provides insights into the sync status and record health, helping you monitor and troubleshoot connection issues.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the connection whose health status is to be retrieved.

get.description: Retrieve a list of records associated with a specific connection in your HubSpot account. This endpoint allows you to filter records by status and time window, and supports pagination for large result sets. It is useful for obtaining detailed information about the records linked to a particular connection.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the connection for which records are being listed.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: The paging cursor token of the last successfully read resource will be returned as the `paging.next.after` JSON property of a paged response containing more results.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of results to display per page.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter records by their status.

parameters.name: window
parameters.description: Specify a time window for filtering records. The format and valid values are not detailed in the spec.

results.description: An array of public account responses, each representing an individual account with its properties.
An array of PublicConnectionResponse objects, each representing a connection with its details.
An array of PublicFieldMapping objects, each representing a mapping between HubSpot and remote fields.
An array of PublicConnectionRecord objects, each detailing a specific connection record.

total.description: An integer representing the total number of public connection records available.

category.description: The error category, represented as a string.

context.description: An object containing context about the error condition. It consists of additional properties where each key is a string and each value is an array of strings.

correlationId.description: A unique identifier for the request, formatted as a UUID. This should be included with any error reports or support tickets.

errors.description: An array providing further information about the error, with each item being an ErrorDetail object.

links.description: An object mapping link names to associated URIs that contain documentation about the error or recommended remediation steps. Each property is a string.

message.description: A human readable message describing the error along with remediation steps where appropriate. It is of type string.

subCategory.description: A specific category that contains more detailed information about the error, represented as a string.

example.message: Invalid input (details will vary based on the error)

code.description: The status code associated with the error detail. It is a string.

context.description: Context about the error condition, represented as an object where each key is a string and each value is an array of strings.

in.description: The name of the field or parameter in which the error was found. It is a string.

message.description: A human readable message describing the error along with remediation steps where appropriate. It is a string.

subCategory.description: A specific category that contains more specific detail about the error. It is a string.

after.description: A string token used as a cursor to fetch the next set of results in a paginated response.

link.description: A URL string that can be used to directly access the next page of results.

NextPage.description: Specifies the paging information needed to retrieve the next set of results in a paginated API response

before.description: A string token used to fetch the previous page of results in a paginated response.

link.description: A string URL that provides a direct link to access the previous page of results.

PreviousPage.description: specifies the paging information needed to retrieve the previous set of results in a paginated API response

accountIdentifier.description: A string that uniquely identifies the account within the system.

accountInstance.description: A string representing the specific instance of the account.

connectionIds.description: An array of strings, each representing the unique identifier of a connection associated with the account.

createdAt.description: The date and time when the account was created, in ISO 8601 format.

id.description: The unique identifier for the account, represented as a string.

name.description: The name of the account, represented as a string.

status.description: The current status of the account, represented as a string. Valid values include 'AUTHENTICATED', 'DISCONNECTED', 'REAUTH_REQUIRED', and 'UNKNOWN'.

code.description: A string representing the unique code associated with this specific finding.

recommendedAction.description: A string suggesting the recommended action to address or resolve the finding.

recordCount.description: An integer representing the count of records related to this finding.

severity.description: A string indicating the severity level of the finding.

summary.description: A string providing a brief summary of the finding.

analysisStatus.description: The current status of the analysis. Valid values include 'COMPLETE', 'INITIALIZING', and 'UNAVAILABLE'.

findings.description: An array of findings from the analysis, each represented by a PublicConnectionAnalysisFinding object.

id.description: The unique identifier for the connection analysis response.

outcome.description: A string representing the outcome of the analysis.

id.description: The unique identifier for the connection, represented as a string.

recordHealth.description: The health status of the records in the connection. Valid values include 'INITIALIZING', 'HEALTHY', 'ISSUES', and 'UNAVAILABLE'.

syncStatus.description: The current synchronization status of the connection. Valid values include 'INITIALIZING', 'SYNCING', 'PAUSED', 'LISTENING', and 'UNAVAILABLE'.

name.description: The name of the parameter, represented as a string.

value.description: The value associated with the parameter, represented as a string.

hubspotObjectId.description: The unique identifier for the object in HubSpot.

lastActivity.description: The type of the last activity performed on the record. Valid values include 'CREATED', 'UPDATED', and 'MATCHED'.

lastActivityAt.description: The date and time when the last activity occurred, in ISO 8601 format.

lastActivitySource.description: The source of the last activity. Valid values include 'HUBSPOT' and 'REMOTE'.

name.description: The name of the connection record.

remoteObjectId.description: The unique identifier for the object in the remote system.

status.description: The current status of the connection record. Valid values include 'IN_SYNC', 'FAILING', and 'EXCLUDED'.

excluded.description: The number of records that are excluded from synchronization. This is an integer value formatted as int64.

failing.description: The number of records that have failed to synchronize. This is an integer value formatted as int64.

inSync.description: The number of records that are successfully synchronized. This is an integer value formatted as int64.

categories.description: An array of strings representing the categories of the error. Valid categories include 'MISSING_REQUIRED_FIELD', 'MISSING_REQUIRED_PROPERTY', 'MISSING_ASSOCIATED_RECORD', 'MISSING_ASSOCIATED_INVOICE', 'ASSOCIATED_CONTACT_WITHOUT_COMPANY', 'RECORD_LIMIT_EXCEEDED', 'VALUE_ALREADY_TAKEN', 'INVALID_FIELD', 'INVOICE_DETAILS_UPDATE_NOT_ALLOWED', 'INVOICE_STATUS_UPDATE_NOT_ALLOWED', 'INVOICE_DETAILS_NOT_ALLOWED', 'FORBIDDEN', 'CANCELED_ACCOUNT', 'INTERNAL_ERROR', 'DUPLICATE_RECORD', 'DELETED', 'DUPLICATE', and 'UNCATEGORIZED'.

message.description: A string containing a human-readable message describing the error.

side.description: Indicates the side where the error occurred. Valid values include 'HUBSPOT', 'REMOTE', and 'BOTH'.

accountId.description: The unique identifier for the account associated with this connection.

createdAt.description: The date and time when the connection was created, in ISO 8601 format.

direction.description: The direction of data flow for the connection. Valid values include 'TWO_WAY', 'INBOUND', and 'OUTBOUND'.

id.description: The unique identifier for the connection.

objectType.description: The type of object involved in the connection, represented as a string.

objectTypeId.description: The identifier for the type of object involved in the connection.

params.description: An array of parameters associated with the connection, each represented by a PublicConnectionParam object.

remoteObjectType.description: The type of object on the remote system that is involved in the connection.

status.description: The current status of the connection. Valid values include 'CREATED', 'STARTED', and 'PAUSED'.

updatedAt.description: The date and time when the connection was last updated, in ISO 8601 format.

id.description: The unique identifier for the connection, represented as a string.

status.description: The current status of the connection. Valid values include 'CREATED', 'STARTED', and 'PAUSED'.

direction.description: A string indicating the direction of data synchronization. Valid values include 'TWO_WAY', 'INBOUND', and 'OUTBOUND'.

status.description: A string representing the current status of the field mapping. Valid values include 'ENABLED' and 'DISABLED'.

crmProperty.description: The CRM property associated with the HubSpot mapping field, represented as a string.

id.description: The unique identifier for the HubSpot mapping field, represented as a string.

label.description: The human-readable name for the HubSpot mapping field, represented as a string.

id.description: The unique identifier for the remote field. It is a string that distinguishes this field from others in the remote system.

label.description: A human-readable name for the remote field. This string is used to identify the field in user interfaces or documentation.

upstreamFieldId.description: The identifier of the field in the upstream system. This string is used to map the field in the context of data synchronization.
